Succession Planning Rapid expansion of the company geographically and its business diversification into other streams has created the need for new business leaders across various verticals. The development of right talent and their timely appointment is an important aspect. Contractual disputes With changing legal and regulatory landscape in the country many legal issues are emerging with the growth in the business.
